question: How far does the pervading presence of Siddhimatrika extend?
premises: The cosmos is described from the cosmic egg to the outer shell.
The goddess is identified as Siddhimatrika.
The speaker bows to her in relation to this cosmic extent.
inference: Siddhimatrika is revered as pervading the entire cosmos.
uncertainties: Whether the accusative denotes extent pervaded or scope of praise is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: I bow to her, Siddhimatrika, who extends from the cosmic egg to the outer shell of the universe.
